what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Iraq in Lebanon: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2342 Iraqi asylum seekers in Lebanon, 2.4% of all asylum seekers from Iraq.
Refugees from Iraq, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1995 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents since 2004.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in some years up to 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 2570 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2009.
The figure was at its highest, 13976, at the end of 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2020.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Lebanon.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Lebanon only.
